name: @growae/reactive-wasm-js-binding
description: WIT world and jco-transpiled JS glue over ae-core. A frozen reference artifact with no consumer — see README. Not published.

scripts.build:rust: cd core-component && CARGO_HOME_RESOLVED="${CARGO_HOME:-$HOME/.cargo}" REPO_ROOT="$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel)" RUSTFLAGS="--remap-path-prefix=$CARGO_HOME_RESOLVED=/cargo-home --remap-path-prefix=$REPO_ROOT=/workspace" cargo component build --release --target wasm32-unknown-unknown
scripts.build:js: rm -rf generated && mkdir generated && jco transpile core-component/target/wasm32-unknown-unknown/release/core_component.wasm -o generated --name core-harness --minify
scripts.build: pnpm run build:rust && pnpm run build:js
